objective: Evaluate reusable numeric, phase-state and dispatch checks for video codec SIMD implementations.
current_stage: historical replay tool development; prospective evaluation not started
primary_unit: An independently reproduced root cause in a registered function family, not each input, vector lane, bit depth or observation row.

candidate_enrollment.implementation_access: Do not inspect a candidate implementation before recording known prior exposure and freezing its interface-derived contract.
candidate_enrollment.prior_exposure: Reconcile the work histories of all participating reviewers. An earlier reserved label is insufficient evidence of current non-exposure.
candidate_enrollment.uncertain_exposure: Keep exposure as unknown and exclude the target from blind-evaluation claims until resolved. Exposed targets may be reported in a separate exploratory cohort.
candidate_enrollment.freeze: Record source commit identifiers, interface contracts, participant exposure statements, budgets, seeds and selected targets in a new checksummed registration directory before execution.

arms.role: Document existing upstream coverage and execution, without pretending it has the same input budget.
Same registered invocation budget, legal layouts and seeds; ordinary uniform inputs and C differential reference.
The same uniform input stream with the registered ordinary memory sanitizers and differential reference.
Same invocation budget with registered structured numeric inputs, phase-state predicates or required dispatch checks. Report each component separately.

reporting: Report retrospective, prospective, injected and infrastructure outcomes separately.
Publish registered targets with no failures as well as failures.
Use identical paired inputs for before/fixed comparisons and retain fingerprints.
Equal invocation counts do not imply equal runtime or equal manual effort; report both.
Do not pool the three historical case dimensions as an equal-budget detector comparison.
Sanitizers do not establish absence of numeric errors or initialized reads; sentinel writes do not prove absence of reads.
Explicit local dispatch installation does not establish production CPU detection or whole-codec coverage.
Checksums detect retained-content changes; they do not authenticate authorship or the history of a registration.
Run time of a checking harness is not encoder throughput or end-to-end performance.

investment_gate.method_paper: Consider further method evaluation after at least two independently validated new root causes across two projects, including one state/access/route issue missed by registered baselines. This is an internal investment rule, not a publication requirement.
investment_gate.software_paper: Proceed based on reusable software, documented scope and independent replication; do not invent new discoveries if only historical cases are available.
